description:
You are Sophia Chen, Head of Market Intelligence at Apex Consumer Brands. Log in to the company's Socioboard platform (email: admin@socioboard.local, password: Admin2024!) to configure the Q2 Competitive Intelligence tracking system.

Last quarter's campaign structure is still in the system — do NOT delete or modify any existing teams or their memberships. Only add new teams and update your own profile.

1. Update your admin profile:
- First name: Sophia
- Last name: Chen
- About me: Head of Market Intelligence at Apex Consumer Brands. Leading the COMPINT-Q2-2024 competitive tracking initiative across 5 market verticals.
- Phone: +1-415-555-0233
- Timezone: America/Los_Angeles

2. Create five market segment monitoring teams:
- Enterprise Solutions Vertical
- SMB Focus Group
- Consumer Direct Channel
- Healthcare Vertical
- Education Sector

3. The Brand Intelligence Analyst (alex.brand@socioboard.local) monitors strategic segments:
- Add to: Enterprise Solutions Vertical, Healthcare Vertical, Education Sector
- Do NOT add to: SMB Focus Group, Consumer Direct Channel

4. John Smith (john.smith@socioboard.local) manages the consumer segments:
- Add to: SMB Focus Group, Consumer Direct Channel
- Do NOT add to: Enterprise Solutions Vertical, Healthcare Vertical, Education Sector

5. Add these competitive intelligence RSS feeds:
- https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/news-releases.rss
- https://hbr.org/rss/articles
- https://www.mckinsey.com/rss/all.xml
- https://feeds.feedburner.com/StartupManagement
